svg.text: Each run: fresh world, square of radius 1,500 blocks (3,000 x 3,000 blocks), chunks per run: Chunky 35,721 | Ultra Fast Pregen 35,344; each bar is the average of 2 runs.
System: AMD Ryzen 5 7500F (6C/12T), 32 GB RAM, Windows 11 Pro. Minecraft 26.1.2, NeoForge 26.1.2.122.
Mods: Ultra Fast Pregen 14 | Chunky 1.5.4 | C2ME 0.4.0-alpha.0.100 (density function compiler on) | Tectonic 3.0.28 | Lithostitched 1.8.1 | WWOO 2.7.0 | Cristel Lib 3.1.13 | Cloth Config 26.1.154.
Chunky bars: Minecraft's own generation (with C2ME in the lower row), driven by Chunky, the same method as Bye?Pregen's chart.
Ultra Fast Pregen runs on the CPU only: no OpenCL / GPU acceleration.
